name: Thunder Pulse
description: The creature chooses a direction, then pushes unsecured objects inside its space that aren't being worn or carried 30 feet away in that direction. Each creature in the creature's space must make a DC 16 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 14 (2d8 + 5) bludgeoning damage plus 13 (3d8) thunder damage, is knocked prone, and is pushed 30 feet in the same direction.
